# Memory leak in Node.js API growing across days

A Node service slows down and must be restarted every few days to stay responsive.

An event-emitter listener was added per request but never removed, so listeners and their closures accumulated, leaking memory that GC could not reclaim.

1. Take heap snapshots over time and diff retained objects
2. Find the growing listener count and remove listeners on request end
3. Deploy the fix and watch RSS flatten
4. Add a memory-growth alert and periodic snapshot in staging

Error Details
```
FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory; process RSS climbing linearly; --max-old-space-size hit
```

Tags: infra, memory-leak, nodejs, heap-oom, event-listener
